# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
DATA_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
CAND_DIR     <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "candidates")
OUT_meanATAC_DIR  <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores", "meanATAC")
OUT_varianceATAC_DIR  <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores", "varianceATAC")
dir.create(OUT_meanATAC_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(OUT_varianceATAC_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2. Inputs/Parameters
```{r}
seurat_rds   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")
cands_dir    <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "candidates")
assay_name   <- "ATAC"
celltypes_tsv <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "celltypes.tsv")
celltype_col <- "cell_type_manual"
```

# 3. Generate Scores
```{r}
seo <- readRDS(seurat_rds)
stopifnot(celltype_col %in% colnames(seo@meta.data))

keys_df <- read.delim(celltypes_tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
col_key <- if ("celltype_key" %in% names(keys_df)) "celltype_key" else names(keys_df)[1]
keys <- unique(trimws(keys_df[[col_key]]))
keys <- keys[!is.na(keys) & nzchar(keys)]

## ---------- main loop ----------
for (key in keys) {
  ct <- key
  message("\n=== Processing cell type: ", ct, " ===")
  
  # subset cells of this cell type
  cells_ct <- rownames(seo@meta.data)[seo@meta.data[[celltype_col]] == ct]
  if (length(cells_ct) < 2L) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (only ", length(cells_ct), " cell(s))")
    next
  }
  seo_ct <- subset(seo, cells = cells_ct)
  
  # peak x cell counts (sparse)
  C <- GetAssayData(seo_ct, assay = assay_name, slot = "counts")
  
  # binarize: open if >=1 fragment 
  B <- (C > 0) + 0
  
  # proportion-accessible per peak (p in [0,1]); Bernoulli variance p*(1-p)
  p <- Matrix::rowMeans(B)
  peak_stats <- data.frame(
    peak_id   = rownames(B),
    mean_atac = as.numeric(p),
    #var_atac  = as.numeric(p * (1 - p)), # this should be changed to
    var_atac  = Seurat:::RowVarSparse(B),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # read candidates and attach peak-level stats to each peak–gene pair
  cand_file <- file.path(CAND_DIR, paste0("candidates_", key, ".tsv"))
  cand <- fread(cand_file)
  if (!"peak_id" %in% names(cand)) {
    stop("File lacks 'peak_id' column: ", f)
  }
  
  mean_tbl <- merge(cand, peak_stats[, c("peak_id","mean_atac")], by = "peak_id", all.x = TRUE)
  data.table::setnames(mean_tbl, "peak_id", "peak")  
  
  var_tbl  <- merge(cand, peak_stats[, c("peak_id","var_atac")],  by = "peak_id", all.x = TRUE)
  data.table::setnames(var_tbl,  "peak_id", "peak")

  # write per-celltype outputs
  outfile_mean <- file.path(OUT_meanATAC_DIR, paste0("links_with_meanATAC_", ct, ".tsv"))
  outfile_var  <- file.path(OUT_varianceATAC_DIR,  paste0("links_with_ATACvariance_", ct, ".tsv"))
  fwrite(mean_tbl, outfile_mean, sep = "\t")
  fwrite(var_tbl,  outfile_var,  sep = "\t")
  
  # quick logs
  message("Wrote: ", outfile_mean, " (n=", nrow(mean_tbl), ")")
  message("Wrote: ", outfile_var,  " (n=", nrow(var_tbl),  ")")
}

message("\nAll done.")
```
